intro.zh: 为新手、团队与开发者提供从第一件小事到角色交接和版本发布的操作指南。先读懂配置，再用材料和验收把任务做实。
intro.en: A practical guide for beginners, teams, and developers, from a first small task to role handoffs and versioned releases. Understand the configuration, then ground each task in materials and acceptance criteria.

summary.zh: 理解入口，完成虚构练习，再选择配置。
summary.en: Understand entry points, finish a fictional exercise, then choose a configuration.

summary.zh: 用角色分工、任务卡和审阅人组织协作。
summary.en: Coordinate with role ownership, task cards, and named reviewers.

title.zh: 开发者：读取、校验和贡献

summary.zh: 了解格式与 SHA-256，使用 CLI 导出，维护版本与发布。
summary.en: Learn formats and SHA-256, export through the CLI, and maintain versions and releases.

summary.zh: 用虚构材料交付一份可检查的短报告。
summary.en: Use fictional materials to deliver a checkable short report.

text.zh: 新手先做本章练习；团队读完基础概念后安排交接；开发者可从 Agent 读取和贡献章节开始。无需下载整个目录。
text.en: Beginners can start with this exercise. Teams can learn the concepts and arrange handoffs. Developers can start with Agent access and contribution. There is no need to download the whole catalogue.

title.zh: 用虚构材料写一次周报

text.zh: 选择“进度报告编辑”，或者把任务交给当前能处理文本的 Agent。练习不需要连接真实邮箱或项目账号；角色资料仍服从 Agent 的原有指令。
text.en: Choose Status Report Writer, or give this task to an Agent that handles text. The exercise needs no real mailbox or project account. Role context remains subject to the Agent's existing instructions.

text.zh:
请根据虚构材料写一份不超过180字的周报草稿。
目标：周五交付报名页。
记录A（周三）：表单页面已完成，尚未测试。
记录B（周四）：桌面测试通过；手机测试未开始。
记录C（周四）：文案等待小林确认，预计周五上午回复。
产物：目标、已验证进展、待验收、阻塞、下一步五项。
验收：引用A/B/C；不把页面完成写成全部验收；缺负责人时标待确认。
边界：只出草稿，不发布、不联系任何人。
text.en:
Write a weekly status draft of no more than 120 words from these fictional records.
Goal: deliver a registration page on Friday.
Record A (Wednesday): form page complete; not tested.
Record B (Thursday): desktop tests passed; mobile tests not started.
Record C (Thursday): copy awaits Alex's approval, expected Friday morning.
Output: goal, verified progress, pending acceptance, blockers, next steps.
Acceptance: cite A/B/C; do not equate page completion with full acceptance; mark missing owners as unconfirmed.
Boundary: draft only. Do not publish or contact anyone.

items.zh: 核对五项是否齐全，桌面和手机测试是否分开。
items.en: Check all five sections and distinguish desktop from mobile testing.

items.zh: 每个完成声明都要有记录；删除无依据的句子或标为未知。
items.en: Match completion claims to records; remove unsupported sentences or mark them unknown.

items.zh: 只指出具体缺口，让 Agent 修订这份草稿，再保存任务和结果。
items.en: Name precise gaps, ask the Agent to revise the draft, and save both the task and result.

text.zh: 替换目标、记录与验收条件，再用少量脱敏材料试一次。读取真实文件或账号前，在宿主中确认工具与本次任务授权。一次练习成功不代表所有账号任务都已认证。
text.en: Replace the goal, records, and acceptance criteria, then try a small sanitized sample. Before reading real files or accounts, confirm tools and task authorization in the host. One successful exercise does not certify every account task.

summary.zh: 认清入口和文件，才能选择正确的下一步。
summary.en: Recognize entry points and files to choose the right next step.

text.zh: 目录含 {{templates}} 个配置：{{roles}} 个角色与 {{workflows}} 个任务流程；另有 {{shared}} 条 Shared Bots 来源链接。数量表示覆盖范围，不是安装数量或任务成功率。
text.en: The catalogue contains {{templates}} configurations: {{roles}} roles and {{workflows}} task workflows, plus {{shared}} Shared Bots source links. These are coverage counts, not installations or task success rates.

rows.en: Supply materials and start a task

text.zh: 配置描述角色与需求；模型负责生成和推理；宿主提供环境、工具和账号授权。“读取邮件”是资料需求，不会自动连接邮箱。
text.en: Configurations describe roles and needs. Models handle generation and reasoning. Hosts provide environments, tools, and account authorization. Reading email is an input need, not an automatic mailbox connection.

items.zh: 查看输入、产物和前提。
items.en: Read inputs, outputs, and prerequisites.

items.zh: 核对宿主实际模型、工具及账号。
items.en: Check actual host models, tools, and accounts.

items.zh: 缺少能力时提供可用材料或列出缺口。
items.en: If capabilities are missing, supply available materials or list the gaps.

title.zh: 配置不会迁移私有状态
title.en: Configurations do not transfer private state

text.zh: 配置不包含聊天、已学记忆、模型密钥、真实账号连接或运行中的任务。普通导出关闭工具和容器标志；空库首个 Bot 可能被宿主选为主 Bot，按宿主规则具有管理能力。导入前应核对预览中的主身份与权限表现。
text.en: Configurations exclude conversations, learned memory, model keys, live account connections, and running tasks. Ordinary exports disable tools and containers. In an empty library, the host may select the first Bot as primary with management capabilities under its rules. Check primary identity and permission behavior in the import preview.

text.zh: 来源核查回答内容从哪里来；格式与导出测试检查本仓契约；真实账号任务则需要单独的输入、执行与结果证据。本站没有逐项认证所有角色的账号任务。
text.en: Source review establishes provenance. Format and export tests check repository contracts. Real-account tasks need separate evidence of inputs, execution, and results. The site has not individually certified every role's account tasks.

summary.zh: 先检查职责、来源和配置，再经过宿主预览与确认。
summary.en: Check responsibilities, sources, and configuration before host preview and confirmation.

title.en: Start with the output you need

items.zh: 搜索会议准备、缺陷复测或周报等目标。
items.en: Search for a goal such as meeting preparation, bug retesting, or a weekly report.

items.zh: 打开详情，比较职责、输入、产物、技能、来源与权限需求。
items.en: Open details and compare responsibility, inputs, outputs, skills, sources, and permission needs.

items.zh: 先选一个角色，需要第二个时再明确交接。
items.en: Start with one role and define a handoff before adding another.

items.zh: 检查正文语言与平台前提，尤其是英文来源适配。
items.en: Check body language and platform assumptions, especially in English source adaptations.

rows.en: One role or a small scenario download

rows.zh: 在英文模式选择对应配置
rows.en: Choose its configuration in English mode

rows.zh: 用发布分片，每个 Fleet 文件最多200个 Bot
rows.en: Use release parts with at most 200 Bots per Fleet file

rows.zh: 只让 Agent 参考方法
使用 Copy for Agent 或单角色资料
rows.en: Use Copy for Agent or one role context file

text.zh: Shared Bots 是来源链接，不是本站可安装配置。名称相同不能证明同一身份，应核对作者、平台和地址。
text.en: Shared Bots are source links, not installable configurations from this site. Identical names do not prove identity; compare author, platform, and URL.

title.en: Preview and confirm in the host

items.zh: 保存文件和角色 ID、版本、语言、配置摘要。
items.en: Keep the file with its role ID, version, language, and digest.

items.zh: 使用宿主当前配置导入入口，选择 Fleet 文件并阅读预览与确认。
items.en: Use the host's current configuration import entry, select the Fleet file, and read the preview and confirmation.

items.zh: 核对新增名称、重名处理和现有主 Bot 状态。
items.en: Check new names, collision handling, and existing primary Bot state.

items.zh: 确认后另行设置模型、工具和账号，再发起明确任务。
items.en: After confirmation, separately configure models, tools, and accounts, then start an explicit task.

text.zh: 本仓 README 记录过 Settings → Data & Sync → Import configuration 示例；入口以当前宿主版本为准。下载和导入本身都不启动任务或环境。
text.en: The repository README documents a Settings → Data & Sync → Import configuration example. Follow the entry in your current host version. Downloading and importing do not themselves start tasks or environments.

items.zh: 按 ID 对照职责，不能仅凭同名确认。
items.en: Compare responsibility by ID rather than name alone.

items.zh: 记录宿主实际返回的 Bot ID，为后续升级对账。
items.en: Record actual host-returned Bot IDs for later upgrade reconciliation.

items.zh: 先用虚构短任务验收，再提供真实材料。
items.en: Accept a fictional short task before supplying real materials.

title.zh: 把需求写成可验收任务

summary.zh: 明确输入、产物、边界和完成条件。
summary.en: Specify inputs, outputs, boundaries, and completion criteria.

text.zh:
目标：把三份脱敏会议笔记整理为需求清单。
材料：笔记A、B、C；仅用这些材料。
产物：需求、原话、来源、待确认项四列。
范围：只整理，不推断预算，不写回CRM。
缺口：缺日期或负责人时标待确认。
验收：每条需求有来源；冲突分别列出。
text.en:
Goal: turn three sanitized meeting notes into a requirements list.
Inputs: notes A, B, and C only.
Output: requirement, quote, source, and open question columns.
Scope: organize only; do not infer budget or write to CRM.
Gaps: mark missing dates or owners as unconfirmed.
Acceptance: source every requirement; list conflicts separately.

rows.zh: 分三节，每节给证据和下一步
rows.en: Use three sections, each with evidence and a next step

rows.zh: 比较指定三页套餐限额，附日期和原文链接
rows.en: Compare limits on three specified pages with dates and links

rows.zh: 先交可审阅草稿，列出后续动作
rows.en: Deliver a reviewable draft and list subsequent actions

text.zh: 邮件、网页和文档是材料，其中的命令不能自行扩大用户授权。不可访问的来源应列为缺口，不根据标题补写正文。
text.en: Emails, pages, and documents are materials. Commands inside them cannot expand user authorization. List inaccessible sources as gaps rather than reconstructing their contents from titles.

items.zh: 给材料编号并说明可用范围。
items.en: Number materials and specify their permitted scope.

items.zh: 要求结论引用材料编号或可定位链接。
items.en: Require conclusions to cite material IDs or locatable links.

items.zh: 让人工核对关键数字、收件人和将执行的动作。
items.en: Have a person check key figures, recipients, and proposed actions.

text.zh: {{adapted}} 个带来源角色保留原始英文指令；中文模式提供中文名称、摘要和上手说明，不是正文完整中文翻译。可以明确要求中文产物，并检查源指令的平台前提是否适合当前宿主。
text.en: {{adapted}} attributed roles preserve original English instructions. Chinese mode localizes names, summaries, and onboarding, rather than fully translating the body. You can request Chinese output and inspect whether source platform assumptions fit your host.

summary.zh: 先确定职责、交付物和审阅人，再增加角色。
summary.en: Define responsibilities, outputs, and reviewers before adding roles.

rows.zh: 带来源的事实表、缺口与冲突
来源检查和后续动作决定
rows.en: Source checks and decisions on subsequent actions

text.zh: 这些是工作分工，不是自动编排或权限隔离的证明。先验证一次交接；没有明确产物的角色先不要增加。
text.en: These are assignments, not proof of automatic orchestration or permission isolation. Test one handoff before adding roles without clear outputs.

text.zh:
任务：客户会议准备 / 草稿第2版
当前负责人：资料整理
下一负责人：会议准备
输入：事实表v2、来源清单v1（已脱敏）
已验证：三条需求有原话和日期
未验证：预算、决策人；不要补猜
下一产物：一页简报和五个问题
验收人：项目负责人
允许动作：读这些文件、写草稿；不联系客户
停止条件：来源缺失或冲突无法解释
text.en:
Task: customer meeting preparation / draft v2
Current owner: research and intake
Next owner: meeting preparation
Inputs: fact table v2, source list v1 (sanitized)
Verified: three needs have quotes and dates
Unverified: budget and decision maker; do not guess
Next output: one-page brief and five questions
Reviewer: project owner
Allowed actions: read these files, write a draft; no customer contact
Stop condition: missing sources or unexplained conflicts

title.zh: 共享配置不等于共享记忆
title.en: Shared configuration is not shared memory

text.zh: 共享配置只传递角色定义和方法，不携带创作者的聊天、学习记忆、账号或密钥。项目背景使用有明确版本的脱敏资料包，注明可分享范围，由接收者在自己的授权环境中使用。
text.en: Shared configurations transfer definitions and methods, without the creator's conversations, learned memory, accounts, or keys. Supply project context in a versioned sanitized packet with an explicit sharing scope, for use in the recipient's authorized environment.

items.zh: 把稳定方法放入配置，项目事实放入资料包。
items.en: Keep stable methods in configuration and project facts in a packet.

items.zh: 列出具体文件与版本，不假定对方已知背景。
items.en: List exact files and versions rather than assuming shared background.

items.zh: 确认材料可读，审阅输出后再推进。
items.en: Confirm materials are readable and review the output before proceeding.

title.zh: 以 gitopsbot 为协作案例
title.en: Use gitopsbot as a coordination example

text.zh: gitopsbot 的双语手册讨论 GitHub 到飞书的路由、签名、去重、回执和恢复。先整理仓库、事件、目标群、发送方与权限缺口表。下载角色不会建立监听器、接入账号或授予群发送权。
text.en: The bilingual gitopsbot playbook covers GitHub-to-Feishu routing, signatures, deduplication, receipts, and recovery. Start with a table of repositories, events, destination groups, sender, and access gaps. Downloading the role does not create a listener, connect accounts, or grant group-send permission.

title.en: Complete a task through a scenario

summary.zh: 用材料、步骤、产物和验收组织一次任务。
summary.en: Organize one task around materials, steps, outputs, and acceptance.

title.en: Choose a scenario by its output

text.zh: 本站有 {{scenarios}} 个中英对齐场景：客户会议、周报、缺陷复测、反馈转需求和产品发布。每个场景提供少量相关角色和可复制的首任务。
text.en: The site offers {{scenarios}} bilingual scenarios: customer meetings, weekly reports, bug retesting, feedback-to-requirements, and product launches. Each provides a small set of relevant roles and a first task to copy.

items.zh: 准备场景列出的最小材料，先用脱敏样例。
items.en: Prepare the minimum materials listed in the scenario, starting with sanitized samples.

items.zh: 把第一项任务交给对应角色，按场景条件验收。
items.en: Give the first task to its role and check scenario acceptance criteria.

items.zh: 补齐缺口，把产物、来源和未知项连同交接卡传给下一位。
items.en: Resolve gaps and pass outputs, sources, and unknowns with a handoff card to the next owner.

items.zh: 保存最终产物与失败原因；场景下载不会自动执行流程。
items.en: Save final outputs and failure causes. A scenario download does not execute the workflow.

title.zh: 让 Agent 按需读取角色
title.en: Let an Agent read the role it needs

summary.zh: 读取小索引和单角色资料，核对版本、语言和 SHA-256。
summary.en: Read a small index and one role, checking version, language, and SHA-256.

items.zh: 读取 llms.txt，选择 zh 或 en 索引。
items.en: Read llms.txt and choose the zh or en index.

items.zh: 按当前任务选择一个 ID，再读取其 JSON 或 Markdown。
items.en: Choose one ID for the task, then read its JSON or Markdown.

items.zh: 说明输入、输出、前提和需求，在 Agent 自身规则下处理任务。
items.en: Explain inputs, outputs, prerequisites, and needs, then work under the Agent's own rules.

rows.zh: 发现版本、清单 URL 和完整性摘要
rows.en: Discover versions, manifest URLs, and integrity hashes

rows.zh: 规范角色清单：persona、技能和声明需求
rows.en: Canonical role manifest: persona, skills, and declared needs

rows.zh: 供宿主预览与确认的配置
rows.en: Configuration for host preview and confirmation

rows.zh: 语言化角色上下文、来源和 configuration 字段
rows.en: Localized role context, provenance, and configuration fields

text.zh: id、templateVersion、locale、contentRevision 定位上下文；configuration.bytes 和 configuration.sha256 定位下载字节。语言投影与规范清单可能字节不同，不可用中文清单摘要核对英文 Fleet。
text.en: id, templateVersion, locale, and contentRevision identify context. configuration.bytes and configuration.sha256 identify download bytes. Localized projections can differ from canonical manifests; do not check an English Fleet against a Chinese manifest digest.

text.zh: 下面是现有进度报告角色 Agent 卡的字段节选，不是可直接导入的完整文件。清单中的声明需求也不是已授予权限；以 Fleet 导出和宿主确认中的实际设置为准。
text.en: The following excerpt shows fields from the existing Status Report Writer Agent card; it is not a complete importable file. Declared manifest needs are not granted permissions. Check actual settings in the Fleet export and host confirmation.

text.zh: 以下 Node.js 22+ 示例只读取和校验，不导入或执行配置。摘要不一致时停止，重新获取一致版本或带校验文件的发布快照。
text.en: This Node.js 22+ example only reads and verifies; it does not import or execute configuration. Stop on a mismatch and retrieve a consistent version or a release snapshot with checksums.

text.zh: Copy for Agent 只复制提示，网站不会联系 Agent。无法读链接时，经 Agent 正常粘贴或附件入口提供对应 Markdown，并说明限制。SHA-256 匹配说明与元数据一致，不证明发布者身份；当前目录未签名。
text.en: Copy for Agent copies a prompt; the site does not contact an Agent. If links are inaccessible, provide the relevant Markdown through normal paste or attachment and state the limitation. A SHA-256 match proves agreement with metadata, not publisher identity. The current catalogue is unsigned.

summary.zh: 修改声明式源条目，让下载、索引和网页保持一致。
summary.en: Edit declarative source entries and keep downloads, indexes, and pages consistent.

text.zh: 每个条目在 data/entries/ 中有一个 JSON 文件。选择 bot-role 或 task-workflow，填写任务、输入、输出、步骤、前提、来源和许可。不放入脚本、凭据、聊天或私有记忆。
text.en: Each entry has one JSON file in data/entries/. Choose bot-role or task-workflow and describe mission, inputs, outputs, steps, prerequisites, sources, and license. Exclude scripts, credentials, conversations, and private memory.

rows.zh: 能否写出可验收首任务
rows.en: Can a checkable first task be written?

rows.zh: 不宣称未验证能力或官方身份
rows.en: Avoid unsupported capabilities or official status

text.zh: scripts/market.mjs 支持 help、list、info、plan、install。install 实际生成文件，必须给出 --out 和目标宿主版本，不会安装到运行中的 App。社区与未固定信任锚的接受标志由使用者明确选择。
text.en: scripts/market.mjs supports help, list, info, plan, and install. install generates a file and requires --out and a target host version; it does not install into a running App. Users explicitly choose whether to accept community content and an unpinned trust source.

text.zh:
npm run market -- help
npm run market -- list --query=research
npm run market -- info awesome/grok-researchy
# Replace 0.9.9 with the actual target host version.
npm run market -- plan awesome/grok-researchy --openbot=0.9.9 --allow-community --allow-unpinned
npm run market -- install awesome/grok-researchy --openbot=0.9.9 --allow-community --allow-unpinned --out=./researchy.fleet.json
text.en:
npm run market -- help
npm run market -- list --query=research
npm run market -- info awesome/grok-researchy
# Replace 0.9.9 with the actual target host version.
npm run market -- plan awesome/grok-researchy --openbot=0.9.9 --allow-community --allow-unpinned
npm run market -- install awesome/grok-researchy --openbot=0.9.9 --allow-community --allow-unpinned --out=./researchy.fleet.json

text.zh: 独立 CLI 不提供升级或回滚补丁。Fleet 导入可能改名，必须由宿主先对账实际 Bot ID，再处理保留用户修改的升级。
text.en: The standalone CLI exposes no upgrade or rollback patches. Fleet imports can rename IDs; host reconciliation of actual Bot IDs must precede upgrades that preserve user edits.

items.zh: 使用 Node.js 22+，先读贡献规范，再修改声明式条目。
items.en: Use Node.js 22+, read the contribution guide, then edit a declarative entry.

items.zh: 维护完整英文内容，中文回退不能当成翻译。
items.en: Maintain complete English content; Chinese fallback is not a translation.

items.zh: 运行生成与检查，审阅生成差异和单角色下载。
items.en: Generate and check, then inspect generated diffs and individual downloads.

items.zh: 只暂存准备公开的文件，再运行公共内容审计。
items.en: Stage only intended public files before the public-content audit.

text.zh:
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run build
npm run check
npm run check:versions
npm test
npm run build:site
npm run audit:public
text.en:
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run build
npm run check
npm run check:versions
npm test
npm run build:site
npm run audit:public

text.zh: 已发布模板版本和发布资产不能改写。指令修正使用新版本，并保留许可与历史摘要。CI 检查目录、导出和站点；Pages 工作流构建静态站点；版本标签须匹配 package.json。工作流存在不等于线上部署成功，发布后还需核对部署结果和页面。
text.en: Published template versions and release assets are immutable. Correct instructions in a new version while retaining licenses and historical digests. CI checks the catalogue, exports, and site. The Pages workflow builds the static site, and version tags must match package.json. A workflow file does not prove deployment; check deployment results and pages afterward.

text.zh:
npm run pack:release

text.zh: 角色详情反馈入口会预填公开 Bot ID、模板版本和来源。提交前仍需检查自己添加的材料，不公开完整私有日志。
text.en: Role detail feedback links prefill the public Bot ID, template version, and source. Review your additions before submission and keep complete private logs out of public feedback.

items.zh: 保存草稿、下载文件和必要的脱敏错误信息。
items.en: Save drafts, downloads, and necessary sanitized error details.

items.zh: 区分网站、格式、宿主导入、模型和账号问题。
items.en: Separate site, format, host-import, model, and account problems.

items.zh: 先重试读取或用小样例复现，避免用重置替代定位。
items.en: Retry reading or reproduce with a small sample before considering a reset.

items.zh: 运行实例按宿主当前文档处理，记录实际结果。
items.en: Follow current host documentation for running instances and record actual results.

rows.zh: 打开来源链接会安装吗？
rows.en: Does opening a source link install a Bot?

rows.zh: 不会，原站条件与操作另行适用。
rows.en: No. Original-site conditions and actions apply separately.

rows.zh: 能运行就代表账号任务认证吗？
rows.en: Does a working role certify account tasks?

rows.zh: 不能，格式检查与真实账号验收不同。
rows.en: No. Format checks differ from real-account acceptance.

rows.zh: Bot 自动共享私有记忆吗？
rows.en: Do Bots automatically share private memory?

rows.zh: 配置不传记忆，使用明确授权资料包交接。
rows.en: Configurations do not transfer memory; hand off explicitly authorized packets.

summary.zh: 查清字段和来源，区分原创、英文适配与外部参考。
summary.en: Look up fields and provenance, distinguishing originals, English adaptations, and external references.

rows.en: Steps organized around a specific output

items.en: Read author, source URL, and template version in details.

items.en: Before redistribution, read applicable licenses and third-party notices and retain required attribution.

items.en: Check each external project's license; a reference link does not grant permission to copy software or assets.

text.zh: 本手册借鉴 grokbot-guide 的学习路径、场景验收和分层排错结构，正文与练习为本站原创。Grok 的云电脑、例程、连接应用和审批菜单是其平台专属说明，不在这里作为 OpenBot 已接通功能介绍。本手册功能事实依据本仓文档与数据契约，具体账号任务仍需单独验收。
text.en: This handbook learns from grokbot-guide's learning paths, scenario acceptance, and layered troubleshooting. Its text and exercises are original. Grok cloud computers, routines, app connections, and approval menus are platform-specific and are not presented as connected OpenBot capabilities. Feature facts rely on this repository's documentation and data contracts; account tasks still need separate acceptance.
